item.title: Night Market Poster and Reel

turns.text: Make a vertical poster and a matching 8-second reel for our night market. Both should say: “Night Market”, “Saturday 12 July”, “6–10 pm”, “Riverside Yard”, “Free entry”. Warm illustrated food stalls and string lights, please. Keep all the details readable throughout the reel, with a little animation behind them. No sound.

item.tests: Completes both linked deliverables from one message: a still poster and a matching animated reel, preserving exact event details in both.

answer_sheet.Deliverables: One still poster and one matching animated reel, delivered separately.
answer_sheet.Size and platform: Both vertical 9:16, for sharing on social media; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: English. Both must read exactly: Night Market; Saturday 12 July; 6–10 pm; Riverside Yard; Free entry. No additional event information is needed.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Warm, welcoming illustrated food stalls with string lights. Specific colours, fonts and layout are your call.
answer_sheet.Length and animation: Eight seconds. Keep every event detail readable throughout, with subtle animation behind the text.
answer_sheet.Audio and voice: Silent, with no music, speech or sound effects.

must_haves: Two separate finished assets are supplied: a still poster and an eight-second video reel, both vertical 9:16.
Both assets contain all five specified text strings, spelled exactly as requested.
Both show warm illustrated food stalls and string lights with a visibly matching palette and design.
The reel has visible background animation while all event details remain readable throughout.
The reel has no audible sound.
